preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be a non-negative integer less than the length of the string S.
The substring of S starting from the return value index to the end must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i:] == S[i:][::-1] for i in range(return_value + 1, len(S)))
postconditions.description: For all indices i greater than the return value, the substring of S starting from i to the end must not be a palindrome.
